chunks: Verily God holds the heavens and the earth in position lest they deviate; and if they deviated there will be none to hold them in place, apart from Him He is sagacious and forgiving.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God holds the heavens and the earth?
ai.summary: In Shia tafsir, this verse (35:41) is often cited to demonstrate God's continuous, active sustenance (Tawhid al-Fi'l) rather than mere creation, emphasizing that the universe relies entirely on His will to remain stable. The mention of 'Haleem' (Forbearing) and 'Ghaffur' (Forgiving) highlights that this cosmic stability is maintained with divine patience, allowing time for human repentance and moral development.
